news.title: Nations League roundup: Lamine Yamal sinks Croatia in Spain’s World Cup homecoming
news.lede: Teenager scores twice in 4-1 win to boost Ballon d’Or case. Slovenia beat North Macedonia; Faroe Islands hold Moldova. Lamine Yamal scored two goals and set up another as Spain hammered Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League in their first home game since lifting the World Cup. Lamine Yamal had opened the scoring within two minutes against England in Saturday’s Wembley win and took just 75 seconds to do so against Slaven Bilic’s side in Andalusia.

news.title: Proof of ‘special’ Socceroos turning point; shift after WC lesson laid bare — Talking Pts
news.lede: In a strange twist of fate, a draw and a loss against Brazil have shown the Socceroos are perfectly placed for a tilt at a second Asian Cup title in January. Australia might have lost the second showdown against the South American giants 4-2 in Brisbane, but the match showed more was right within the Australian set-up than wrong. The side’s confident, front-footed use of the ball across the two games sent a message that Australia is ready to take on the best in the world again, instead of just soaking up pressure against them. news.title: Rare scenes as a draw decided Gulf Cup 27 semifinalists between Oman and Iraq
news.lede: Dubai: Saudi Arabia booked their place in the Gulf Cup 27 semi-finals as Group One winners, but they had to wait for a draw to discover their fellow last-four team after an extraordinary finish to the group stage.The hosts beat Iraq 2-0 at the Alinma Stadium in Jeddah on Tuesday to finish Group A top with nine points. At the same time, Oman fought back from a goal down to beat Kuwait 3-1, leaving Oman and Iraq level on four points in the same group.The situation became complicated because the two teams were level on the relevant qualification criteria. Both had drawn 1-1 in their opening game, while the results of the final round left them level on points and goal difference.

news.title: Chloe Kelly and Ella Toone dropped by England after not hitting ‘expected’ level
news.lede: Chelsea’s Lexi Potter gets first call-up to face Greece. Leah Williamson back after injury for World Cup playoff. Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly have been dropped from England’s squad because of their performance levels by Sarina Wiegman, who has given a first call-up to the 20-year-old ­Chelsea midfielder Lexi Potter. Toone and Kelly have played key roles in England’s run of three consecutive major tournament finals but Wiegman made clear on Tuesday, when announcing her selection for the Women’s World Cup qualifying playoff against Greece, that she wants to see more from them for their clubs.

news.title: Yamal inspires Spain to Croatia romp on World Cup homecoming | Football News
news.lede: Lamine Yamal scored two goals and set up another as Spain hammered Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League in their first home game since lifting the World Cup.Yamal, 19, was joined on the scoresheet by Marc Pubill and Nico Williams as they extended their unbeaten run to 40 matches, which includes June's final triumph over Argentina in the United States.La Roja next play Czech Republic on Saturday in Group A3. Yamal's contribution strengthened his case for the Ballon d'Or, with voting having closed on Monday with the winner announced on October 26. Captain Rodri showed off the World Cup trophy before kick-off at the packed Estadio Ramon Sanchez-Pizjuan, being handed it by Sevilla legend Jesus Navas, a winner with Spain in 2010.
